text: Ideas deserve more than another ordinary slide. Meet All Hands.
Start with your story. Edit titles and text, organize slides, and watch your live preview take shape.
Bring text, bullet points, metrics, quotes, and images together. Resize, reorder, duplicate, or hide the pieces you need.
Upload your own visuals. Control how images fit, then let the audience open them for a closer look.
Choose layouts and themes for team updates, activities, quotes, quizzes, and more. Keep every section part of the story.
Present with keyboard controls, speaker notes, fullscreen, and a blank screen when you need the room. Track the session at a glance.
Move through your deck as a scrolling story. Or open Movie mode and jump straight into the group you want.
Keep activities on track with a built-in timer. Pick a preset or custom duration. Pause, resume, restart, or add thirty seconds.
Save your presentation to a local file. Undo and redo while you edit, and keep an editable JSON copy for later.
Export a web ZIP and email it. Extract, then double-click Open Presentation. Your live deck, images, and modes open offline.
For teams, classrooms, workshops, and creative pitches. Make it memorable. All Hands.
